name: PandaDoc
tagline: Draft proposals, quotes and contracts, and follow them to signature.
summary: Read and work on the user's PandaDoc documents and templates: find documents and their status, read who signed, and draft new ones from templates. Documents are sent for signature, or their status changed, only after the user approves.
can: Find your documents and templates, and read their content, status and history
Draft new documents from your templates, and fill in their fields
Send a document for signature or change its status, only after you approve it
